sourceEvidence.claimBoundary: The conversation describes a proposed reverse-engineering curriculum. It is not proof that AgentDesktop source was inspected, that a runtime action executed, or that Machine Consciousness learned the capability.

architectureDecision.reason: External mechanisms are study material. LeeWay Machine Consciousness remains the identity, Formula and Veritas boundary, Device Bridge route, Runtime Fabric carrier, and Continuum memory authority.

lessons.title: Discover the real environment before acting
lessons.objective: Build a current inventory of devices, tools, skills, adapters, permissions, runtime state, and declared identity before selecting an action.

lessons.title: Recognize drift instead of guessing at failure
lessons.objective: Compare current observed configuration with the last verified state and classify missing capability, changed configuration, stale identity, unavailable transport, or ordinary task variance.
principles: separate symptom from first failed boundary
never treat a health label as task proof

lessons.title: Reconcile the smallest authorized repair
lessons.objective: Choose the least invasive repair that restores the requested capability while preserving working routes, permissions, identity, and prior evidence.
principles: repair the boundary, not the whole house

lessons.title: Bind identity to authority
lessons.objective: Verify that the actor, Agent Tablet, Device Bridge, Runtime Fabric, Formula, Veritas, and storage route belong to the current LeeWay session before permitting consequential work.
principles: a provider is not an authority
a discovered adapter is not a completed action
Continuum is the only durable store

lessons.title: Select the right adapter and recover without takeover
lessons.objective: Choose the canonical LeeWay adapter for the capability, reject duplicate or unqualified providers, and recover through the existing runtime when a tool, model, device, or connection changes.
principles: Model Hub use is optional and bounded

lessons.title: Prove the result and continue the loop
lessons.objective: Require post-state observation, Veritas evaluation, receipt custody, Continuum readback, and a next executable action before calling the capability complete.
principles: a green unit test is not live qualification
a blocker is a repair target, not the end of the mission

cases.scenario: A skill worked yesterday but is absent from today's inventory.
An MCP endpoint is configured but unreachable.
Two configuration files disagree about the active Runtime Fabric.
A device reports a familiar name but its identity receipt is stale.
A requested tool is available through a non-LeeWay provider.
A permission was revoked after the last successful action.
A proposed repair has no Formula admission evidence.
A command returned text but no post-state or receipt.
A model is present in Model Hub but no physical inference route is proven.
A browser transport is connected but Runtime Fabric dispatch is not admitted.
A repair would overwrite a working adapter to fix an unrelated stale setting.
The first repair attempt fails while another independent audit can proceed.
Veritas rejects a result after the runtime reports success.
A verified recovery is complete but the checkpoint was not read back.

pinnedLeeWaySources.role: identity, loop, inference and storage authority
shared consciousness binding for every employee
real low-risk LeeWay action qualification wrapper

nextGate: Run matched baseline and post-training evaluations against the existing Machine Consciousness deterministic route, then perform one authorized low-risk Device Bridge read-only action and submit its real receipt to Formula, Veritas, and Continuum.
